question: Which are the car makers which produce at least 2 models and more than 3 car makers ? List the id and the maker .
query_sqlite: select t1.id ,  t1.maker from car_makers as t1 join model_list as t2 on t1.id  =  t2.maker group by t1.id having count(*)  >=  2 intersect select t1.id ,  t1.maker from car_makers as t1 join model_list as t2 on t1.id  =  t2.maker join car_names as t3 on t2.model  =  t3.model group by t1.id having count(*)  >  3;
sql: SELECT t1.id, t1.maker FROM car_makers AS t1 JOIN model_list AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.maker GROUP BY t1.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 INTERSECT SELECT t1.id, t1.maker FROM car_makers AS t1 JOIN model_list AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.maker JOIN car_names AS t3 ON t2.model = t3.model GROUP BY t1.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

pregunta: ¿Qué cliente hizo la mayor cantidad de reclamación en una sola reclamación? Devuelva los datos del cliente.

sql: SELECT T1.name, T1.age, T1.job FROM Person AS T1 JOIN PersonFriend AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.friend = 'Alice' AND T2.year = (SELECT MAX(YEAR) FROM PersonFriend WHERE friend = 'Alice')
pregunta: Encuentre el nombre, la edad y el título de trabajo de las personas que son amigas de Alice durante los años más largos.

sql: SELECT AVG(t3.count), t3.day FROM category AS t2 JOIN business AS t1 ON t2.business_id = t1.business_id JOIN checkin AS t3 ON t3.business_id = t1.business_id WHERE t1.name = 'Barrio Cafe' AND t2.category_name = 'restaurant' GROUP BY t3.day
pregunta: Encuentra el número medio de cheques en restaurant " Barrio Cafe " por día
